newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY TO PLACE 2.6 MLN RICHTER SHARES PRIVATELY.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY TO PLACE 2.6 MLN RICHTER SHARES PRIVATELY.

text.p: Hungary will place 2.6 million shares in drug producer Richter privately with foreign and domestic institutional investors, probably in early May, Richter said in a statement on Monday.
The company said in the Budapest Stock Exchange's official gazette that further 200,000 Richter shares would be offered to domestic retail investors.
Within the sale of the 2.8 million shares, the state privatisation agency APV will sell 1.8 million of its shares and Richter will issue one million new shares, the company said.
Richter's registered capital is 17.64 billion forints currently. The face value of each shares is 1,000 forints.
APV will price the shares by comparing the bids of investors, Richter said, adding that the sales were likely to follow the pricing of a global offering of oil company MOL's shares, due on May 6.
Domestic retail investors will have to pay only 50 percent of the price at the subscription and the remaining 50 percent after one year, Richter said.
